{
  "title": "A Thrifty Sunday in Cusco",
  "summary": "A relaxed day around the old town, swapping the terraces for free plazas and a lighter bite so the crew keeps more soles in their pockets.",
  "stops": [
    {
      "poi_id": "p11",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": "m2",
      "note": "The crew asked to keep this one, so we start early among the terraces before the day warms up.",
      "start": "09:00",
      "end": "10:15"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p1",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "A free wander around the square gives the photo lovers their shot and the thrifty soul a happy heart.",
      "start": "10:45",
      "end": "11:30"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p4",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "The market stays, but we come for the bustle and street snacks rather than a sit-down meal.",
      "start": "11:45",
      "end": "13:00"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p18",
      "kind": "meal",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "A lighter, lower-priced lunch keeps the day easy on the wallet and the belly.",
      "start": "13:15",
      "end": "14:15"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p7",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "A small museum with a sweet smell, and the entry costs less than the fancier stops we dropped.",
      "start": "14:30",
      "end": "15:30"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p17",
      "kind": "meal",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "Dinner in a courtyard with local flavours, chosen because it is gentler on the budget than the old pick.",
      "start": "19:00",
      "end": "20:15"
    }
  ]
}
